title: Report a stolen vessel or engine as recovered
summary: This page explains how to report a vessel or engine that was previously reported as stolen, but has since been recovered.
intro: A vessel or engine that was previously reported as stolen, but has now been found, will need to be reported to Transport for NSW.
what_you_need: vessel or engine details such as HIN (Boatcode), registration number or engine serial number
written notification that the vessel or engine has been recovered

how_to_steps.text: Make sure you have all the required documents.
Visit a Service NSW Centre and provide the information in person, or by post to:Service NSWPO Box 21Parkes NSW 2870.
